verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server on its developer resources page. It lets developers use natural language to connect agents to Adyen's platform, and a probe confirmed the documented page exists. The evidence is thin on detail, though: it doesn't show which tools or APIs are exposed, or whether the Adyen for Platforms APIs (Legal Entity Management, Configuration, splits, payouts) are covered. missing for 10: specifics of the MCP tool and API coverage for platform features, setup and authentication details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
